title: Livestock
description: Livestock catalogue entry referencing the Livestock Category and Livestock Breed catalogues.

livestockId.description: System-generated primary identifier for this catalogue entry.

livestockCategoryId.description: Reference to the Livestock Category catalogue entry. The UI should populate this value from the Livestock Category catalogue.

livestockbreedId.description: Reference to the Livestock Breed catalogue entry. The UI should populate this value from the Livestock Breed catalogue and filter available breeds using livestockCategoryId.

livestock.description: Type/species of the livestock. This field may be retained for backward compatibility; the authoritative category reference is livestockCategoryId.

breed.description: Breed name. This field may be retained for backward compatibility; the authoritative breed reference is livestockbreedId.

locationType.description: Agro-ecological zone the breed is adapted to; absent when not applicable.

gender.description: Gender this reference entry describes; absent when not applicable.

productionType.description: Typical production purpose for this breed/gender combination.

liveWeightKg.description: Typical/average mature live body weight in kilograms.

heightCm.description: Typical/average height at withers in centimeters.

coatColor.description: Predominant/standard coat, skin, or plumage color.

averageMilkYieldLitersPerDay.description: Reference average daily milk yield in liters.

averageEggProductionPerWeek.description: Reference average eggs produced per week.

averageDailyWeightGainGrams.description: Reference average daily weight gain in grams.

woolFiberYieldKg.description: Reference wool/fiber yield in kilograms per shearing cycle.

honeyYieldKgPerHarvest.description: Reference honey yield in kilograms per harvest.
